ValidationRule.description: CR-13 / CAT-07: the quote's term (Quote > Term (Months), RLM_TermMonths__c) must be one the product allows (Product > Allowed Term Months, e.g. Enterprise 24 or 36). Mindbody term-defined lines only; no check while the quote term is still blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( BEGINS(Product2.ProductCode, 'MB-'), ISPICKVAL(ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType, 'TermDefined'), NOT(ISBLANK(Product2.Allowed_Term_Months__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Quote.RLM_TermMonths__c)), OR( AND(Quote.RLM_TermMonths__c = 12, NOT(INCLUDES(Product2.Allowed_Term_Months__c, '12'))), AND(Quote.RLM_TermMonths__c = 24, NOT(INCLUDES(Product2.Allowed_Term_Months__c, '24'))), AND(Quote.RLM_TermMonths__c = 36, NOT(INCLUDES(Product2.Allowed_Term_Months__c, '36'))), AND(Quote.RLM_TermMonths__c <> 12, Quote.RLM_TermMonths__c <> 24, Quote.RLM_TermMonths__c <> 36) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The quote's Term (Months) is not offered for this product. Set the quote term to 12, 24 or 36 months as allowed by the product (Enterprise: 24 or 36; TAM: 12).
